title: Payment Factor Schedule — Rebuilding a Payment on Belrose Promotional Financing Plans
content:
# Payment Factor Schedule — Rebuilding a Payment on Belrose Promotional Financing Plans

The share of the balance that makes up the principal part of a rebuilt payment on a Belrose Promotional Financing Plan is read from the plan's standing and its history of billing.

| The plan at the handling date | The payment factor |
|---|---|
| Stands past due | This desk's arrears factor of **4.5 percent** |
| Automatic payment is in force on it, **and** it has been billing for at least the term's repricing review length in whole calendar months | This desk's steady-payer factor of **2.4 percent** |
| Any other case | The term's payment factor |

A past due plan takes the arrears factor whether or not automatic payment is in force on it.

## Figures by term

| Term | Repricing review length, whole months | The term's payment factor |
|---|---|---|
| 6-Month Deferred Interest Plan | 6 | 16.67 percent |
| 12-Month Deferred Interest Plan | 6 | 8.34 percent |
| 18-Month Deferred Interest Plan | 6 | 5.56 percent |
| 24-Month Equal Payment Plan | 6 | 4.17 percent |
| 36-Month Equal Payment Plan | 12 | 2.78 percent |
| 48-Month Bridal Equal Payment Plan | 12 | 2.09 percent |

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

- A plan on the 12-Month Deferred Interest Plan standing past due: the factor is 4.5 percent, not that term's 8.34 percent.
- A plan on the 36-Month Equal Payment Plan standing active with automatic payment in force, billing for 14 whole calendar months against a review length of 12: the factor is 2.4 percent.
- The same plan billing for 8 whole calendar months: the review length of 12 is not reached, so the factor is that term's 2.78 percent.
- A plan on the 6-Month Deferred Interest Plan standing active without automatic payment: the factor is that term's 16.67 percent.
